Thanks Rachel — we wrapped internal evals this morning and are aligned to make a go/no-go decision by end of week. Two asks before we lock dates: 1) a single-page MAP with approvals and signers (who signs when), and 2) a clear start-date/options for onboarding (preferred week of May 6). Can you share the playbook and the expected DocuSign flow so our procurement and legal teams can confirm availability?

Elena — great to hear. Attaching the latest MAP (v3) and a draft SOW that matches the MAP milestones. Short summary below: 1) Approvals ladder: procurement -> legal -> exec (Elena) -> ops (Tom). 2) Signature routing: Redwood signs first (Account Exec + VP Sales), then DocuSign routes to Elena, then Tom. 3) Proposed hard start: any day the week of May 6 — we can stand up the private VPC connectors during the first 48 hours; full onboarding (health checks, runbook handoff) completes in 10 business days.

Please see attached: MAP_StellarSuite_v3.xlsx, SOW_StellarSuite_v1.pdf. Also adding a CSV with our suggested signer routing for DocuSign.

Next steps: If procurement/legal confirm signer order, I can trigger the DocuSign envelope tomorrow morning (we can set signature expiry to 7 days).

—Rachel
